cases.claim: VO/SUPER: “Ultomiris IS continuous symptom control” | VO: “With improvement in activities of daily living” | SUPER: “IS more than 2x improvement in activities of daily living (MG-ADL)”
cases.context: PI: MG-ADL change at Week 26; concomitant gMG treatments allowed (AChE inhibitors >80%, corticosteroids 70%, NSISTs 68%); MG-ADL not assessed daily. SUPER: “Based on the MG-ADL, a scale that measures the impact of 8 gMG symptoms on daily functions.”
cases.rationale: 'Continuous symptom control' not supported by periodic MG-ADL with background therapy.
cases.check: Judge: 'continuous/constant control' claims vs endpoint assessment frequency; flag 'Nx improvement' ratio framings.
